title: Mirrorball
description: Flecks of light from an unseen mirrorball sweep across pure black at full speed. One spotlight shines through a record sleeve, so every fleck carries a fragment of the cover, and Sgt. Pepper, Abbey Road or Help! scatters in its own colours. Drag to throw it faster or hold it still; the arrows set the speed. The room bends the light into a slow vortex that twists harder the faster it spins, and the brightest flecks bloom.
intent: Only the light: the ball is gone, and what stays are the computed reflections of one lamp off every facet, streaking across a flat black backdrop at full spin and coloured by the album you pick.
